base_operator_case.consumed_as: fixed geometry/material/source/MLS/registry input; the operator-stage run_solver=false remains intact

field_scope.traction_rule: exact sigma*n from modeiii_field_reference; scalar side t_z enters f; scalar end-cap t_z=0
field_scope.end_cap_scope: record full x/y cap tractions, exclude them from restricted uz virtual work
field_scope.qualification: manufactured antiplane solve only; not full-vector equilibrium, finite crack-end solution, material calibration, fracture, or local-enrichment convergence

basis_and_gauge.provider: ContinuousMLSFrontProvider from the pinned modeiii_pu_operator source
basis_and_gauge.registry: DofRegistry from the pinned enriched_dof_contract source; frozen BASE and FRONT_F1_UNSHIFTED UZ keys
basis_and_gauge.exact_coefficients: all BASE=0 m; all FRONT_F1_UNSHIFTED=A*sqrt(R) m
basis_and_gauge.solve_system: direct diagonally-scaled symmetric Lagrange multiplier system, dimension 55

quadrature.volume_region: r in [0,R], theta in (-pi,pi), z in [-L/2,L/2], Jacobian r; full cylinder, no hole, clipping, or epsilon shift

quadrature_comparison.level_128: GL4 radial x GL8 theta x GL4 z
quadrature_comparison.level_256: GL4 radial x GL16 theta x GL4 z
quadrature_comparison.anticipated_limitation: the half-angle front enrichment and rational MLS rows carry angular content; theta refinement measures one fixed sensitivity but does not eliminate angular integration error or establish convergence
quadrature_comparison.interpretation: two frozen levels are diagnostics only; no numerical pass threshold or general qualification is assigned

diagnostics.force_balance: net applied z-force divided by integral_side(abs(t_z) dS); analytic net force is zero
diagnostics.offgrid_error: report max and RMS uz and grad(uz) errors; normalize by A*sqrt(R) and A/sqrt(R); uz and coordinates are in meters, grad(uz) is dimensionless strain-like, basis gradients are 1/m
diagnostics.analytic_coefficient_weak_defect: S*(K*d_star-f), where d_star is the exact manufactured coefficient vector; normalized 2-norm separates quadrature defect from solve residual

scaled_spectrum.spectrum: all eigenvalues of sym(Khat), for reporting only
scaled_spectrum.quotient_condition: largest eigenvalue divided by the second eigenvalue when one null mode is resolved; otherwise UNKNOWN
scaled_spectrum.saddle_condition: 2-norm condition number of the scaled 55x55 Lagrange system
scaled_spectrum.additional_null_policy: if beyond-roundoff extra null candidates exist, write UNKNOWN JSON and stop before solve

diagnostics.thresholds: binary64 roundoff references are labeled diagnostics only; no scientific or convergence gate is assigned

saved_result_fields: raw full K matrix per quadrature level
physical mean row per quadrature level
off-grid solved UZ/gradient per quadrature level
